paragraphs.text: Vizier Qhattib (qhaht-teeb ) of Amiqat was the ruler of Suq'Ata during the Mirage Wars of Dominaria .

Qhattib was the legislative voice that offset Telim'Tor ’s military command. His considerable knowledge of the djinns and efreets of Jamuraa could be attributed to his links with the Wildfire plane. Although Suq'Ata was the least damaged of the three countries that fought against Kaervek , the Breathstealers of Urborg that had aided the dark mage remained in Suq'Ata and were a great danger to the nation. Qhattib discovered this shortly after the war, as he was assassinated by the Breathstealer Hilel .
The vizier's name is derived from the Arabic name Khatib, meaning "speaker".
